categories.label: Layout
categories.description: Primitives for structure, spacing, alignment, and responsive layout.

categories.label: Typography
categories.description: Components for semantic text, headings, and readable content.

categories.label: Actions
categories.description: Controls that trigger user actions, commands, and primary interactions.

categories.label: Inputs
categories.description: Form controls for collecting and editing user-provided values.

categories.label: Navigation
categories.description: Components that move users between views, sections, and destinations.

categories.label: Data display
categories.description: Components for presenting structured values, status, and information.

categories.label: Feedback
categories.description: Loading, progress, validation, empty-state, and status feedback.

categories.label: Overlays
categories.description: Layered UI such as dialogs, popovers, menus, and tooltips.

categories.label: Media
categories.description: Components for images, icons, avatars, and other visual media.

categories.label: Utilities
categories.description: Low-level helpers that support composition without defining a major UI domain.

components.name: ActionIcon
components.description: Compact icon-only native button with an accessible name.
accessibility: Requires ariaLabel because icon-only controls need an accessible name.

components.name: Autocomplete
components.description: Searchable single-value selection control backed by the shared Combobox engine.
accessibility: Filtering preserves a valid active descendant by option value and falls back to the first enabled visible option when needed.
Empty results remove aria-activedescendant and announce the nothingFound content as status text.
Clear is forwarded consistently with Select and MultiSelect.

components.name: Badge
components.description: Compact status label using semantic color and variant tokens.

components.name: Box
components.description: Low-level polymorphic container with token-based spacing.

components.name: Button
components.description: Native button control with doctui color, variant and size tokens.
accessibility: Uses a native button element.
Loading state disables interaction and exposes aria-busy.
Focus-visible styles use the theme focus ring token.

components.name: Calendar
components.description: Month calendar that emits ISO date selections.
accessibility: Uses labeled native buttons and exposes selected dates with aria-pressed.

components.name: Center
components.description: Flex helper that centers content on both axes.

components.name: Checkbox
components.description: Native checkbox semantics with doctui-controlled visual geometry and shared field messaging.
accessibility: Keeps a native checkbox as the semantic, focus and keyboard source while rendering a custom visual indicator.
Disabled and required behavior uses native form semantics.

components.name: Code
components.description: Monospace inline or block code presentation.

components.name: Combobox
components.description: Focus-managed listbox engine used by doctui selection controls.
accessibility: Keeps DOM focus on the native combobox input and exposes the active enabled option through aria-activedescendant.
Arrow keys, Home and End skip disabled options; filtering never leaves aria-activedescendant pointing at a missing option.
Visible labels use the shared field relationship; ariaLabel is supported when no visible label is rendered, with a safe fallback accessible name.
examples: <Combobox v-model="framework" :data="frameworks" searchable aria-label="Search framework" nothing-found="No matches" />

components.name: Container
components.description: Centered responsive container constrained by theme breakpoints.

components.name: DateInput
components.description: Native date input with doctui field labeling and clear behavior.
accessibility: Uses a native date input associated with its visible label.

components.name: DatePicker
components.description: Date input with an optional calendar selection panel.
accessibility: The calendar toggle exposes expanded state and calendar buttons are keyboard accessible.

components.name: DateTimePicker
components.description: Native date-time input with Vue v-model support.

components.name: Divider
components.description: Separator for related content with optional label content.
accessibility: Uses role=separator and exposes its orientation.

components.name: Drawer
components.description: Accessible side dialog with shared overlay, nested-layer dismissal and focus restoration.
accessibility: Uses role=dialog and aria-modal, traps focus, closes on Escape when enabled and restores the trigger on close.
A visible title provides aria-labelledby; ariaLabel names titleless drawers, with Drawer as a safety fallback.
Shared scroll locking is reference-counted so closing one nested layer never unlocks the page under another open layer.

components.name: Flex
components.description: Flexbox layout primitive with theme-token gaps.

components.name: Grid
components.description: CSS grid layout primitive with token-backed gaps and columns.

components.name: Group
components.description: Horizontal wrapping layout for related controls and content.

components.name: InputWrapper
components.description: Shared label, description, required and error structure for inputs.
accessibility: Generates an SSR-safe control ID when one is not provided and associates the visible label with that ID.
Keeps description and error messages in the DOM together and exposes both IDs to the scoped control slot.

components.name: Kbd
components.description: Semantic keyboard shortcut label.

components.name: Loader
components.description: Animated progress indicator for an indeterminate operation.
accessibility: Uses role=status and provides a Loading accessible name.

components.name: Menu
components.description: Keyboard-navigable menu built from native menu item buttons.
accessibility: Uses menu/menuitem roles and supports Arrow, Home, End and Escape.

components.name: Modal
components.description: Accessible modal dialog with nested-layer dismissal, reference-counted scroll lock and focus restoration.
accessibility: Uses role=dialog and aria-modal, traps focus while open, and restores the previously focused element on close.
A visible title provides aria-labelledby; ariaLabel names titleless dialogs, with Dialog as a safety fallback.
Only the top dismissable layer reacts to Escape or outside pointer interaction when dialogs are nested.

components.name: MonthPicker
components.description: Month selection control that emits YYYY-MM values.

components.name: MultiSelect
components.description: Searchable multi-value selection control backed by the shared Combobox engine.
accessibility: Uses aria-multiselectable listbox semantics while keeping DOM focus on the native combobox input.
Backspace removes the last selected value when the search query is empty, and controlled updates immediately refresh aria-selected state.
Clear emits an empty array plus the shared clear event.

components.name: Notifications
components.description: Accessible renderer for notifications managed by a store.
accessibility: Uses a polite live region, status items, and explicit dismiss buttons.

components.name: NumberInput
components.description: Native numeric input with numeric v-model values and range constraints.
accessibility: Uses a native number input with standard keyboard and validation semantics.
Description, error and consumer-provided aria-describedby IDs are composed instead of replacing one another.

components.name: Overlay
components.description: Portal-backed semantic-color backdrop with controlled visibility and dismissal.
accessibility: Backdrop color uses semantic theme tokens and opacity affects only the backdrop, never dialog content.
Overlay is a layering primitive, not a dialog; accessible dialog naming and focus management belong to Modal or Drawer.

components.name: Paper
components.description: Surface container with optional border, radius and shadow.

components.name: PasswordInput
components.description: Password field built on the shared TextInput contract.
accessibility: Uses a native password input and the shared label/help/error relationship contract.
Native form attributes and listeners are forwarded to the password input while class/style customize the outer field root.

components.name: Popover
components.description: Dismissable contextual panel anchored to a target slot.
accessibility: Provides dialog semantics and consistent outside/Escape dismissal.

components.name: Radio
components.description: Native radio option with doctui-controlled visual geometry for a shared scalar v-model.
accessibility: Uses native radio semantics and keyboard behavior; provide the same name for options in one group.
The custom visual indicator does not replace the native input in the accessibility tree.

components.name: SegmentedControl
components.description: Single-selection control with radio semantics and arrow navigation.
accessibility: Uses radiogroup/radio roles; Arrow, Home, End, Enter and Space are supported.

components.name: Select
components.description: Single-value selection control backed by the shared Combobox focus model.
accessibility: Uses the Combobox aria-activedescendant focus model and skips disabled options during keyboard navigation.
Supports a stable public id plus visible-label or ariaLabel accessible naming.
Clear emits both the existing v-model update and the shared clear event.

components.name: Skeleton
components.description: Loading placeholder that can reveal its content when ready.
accessibility: The placeholder is hidden from assistive technology while visible.

components.name: Space
components.description: Semantic layout spacer using the theme spacing scale.

components.name: Stack
components.description: Vertical flex layout for consistent spacing between children.

components.name: Switch
components.description: Boolean toggle that keeps native checkbox behavior behind a doctui track and thumb visual.
accessibility: Uses a native checkbox with role=switch and aria-checked while preserving native keyboard and disabled behavior.
Focus-visible styling is rendered on the visual track without hiding the native focus source from assistive technology.

components.name: TagsInput
components.description: Free-form token field with deterministic parsing, native focus and accessible token-list semantics.
accessibility: Uses InputWrapper for SSR-safe IDs and field relationships while keeping a native text input as the entry and focus target.
Selected tags are exposed as a list with native remove buttons; Backspace on an empty input removes the last tag without moving focus.
Multi-character separators are parsed from input text, while only one-character separators act as keyboard delimiter keys.

components.name: Text
components.description: Semantic text primitive using doctui typography and color tokens.

components.name: Textarea
components.description: Multi-line text field with shared input wrapper semantics.
accessibility: Uses a native textarea and links its label, description and error text through accessible IDs.
Read-only fields remain focusable while disabled fields use native disabled semantics.

components.name: TextInput
components.description: Single-line text field with shared input wrapper semantics.
accessibility: Uses a native input and links its label, description and error text through accessible IDs.
Consumer aria-describedby IDs are composed with doctui-generated message IDs, and error state forces aria-invalid=true.

components.name: Title
components.description: Semantic h1-h6 heading primitive.
accessibility: Heading level is represented by the rendered native h1-h6 element.

components.name: Tooltip
components.description: Non-essential contextual text revealed on hover or focus.
accessibility: Appears on focus as well as hover and is not intended for critical information.

components.name: UnstyledButton
components.description: Native button reset for building custom action surfaces.
accessibility: Preserves native button keyboard and disabled behavior.

components.name: YearPicker
components.description: Year selection control over a configurable range.
